messages:
jade lim: noticed cluster-wide OOMs overnight tied to KV cache growth + allocator fragmentation. opening a dedicated thread to track fixes and owners.

omar ali: thanks jade. which shards were hit and any commonalities?

jade lim: shard-e and shard-f; both show steady post-warmup growth, fragmentation index ~0.44, high small-allocation churn in put/insert. snapshot uploaded: s3://ooms/1985004321/heap.pb

kevin nguyen: initial triage - hot path is kv.insert -> serialize -> memcpy. two levers short-term: cap + smarter eviction. long-term: pooled arenas / slab allocator.

samir patel: infra-bot: Incident 1985004321-kv-oom-frag created. Priority: P1.

infra-bot: Incident 1985004321 created and assigned to eng-runtime oncall.

omar ali: propose immediate actions (short timeframe):
- S1: soft per-shard cache ceiling (owner: kevin) - ETA 24h
- S2: enable aggressive eviction for >100KB entries (owner: jade) - ETA 8h
- S3: continuous 20s heap sampling for 72h (owner: samir) - ETA 1h
- S4: alert: sustained cache growth >7% over 10m (owner: omar) - ETA 3h

kevin nguyen: will implement S1 with throttled evictions to avoid crash loops. will add metrics: evictions/sec, miss-rate, p95. plan canary 1% -> 10%.

jade lim: opening S2 PR now, adding unit tests that assert miss-rate < 2x baseline. PR #4602.

samir patel: starting heap sampling; dumps go to s3://ooms/1985004321/profiles. I'll run a staging compaction bench tonight.

omar ali: logging these in the postmortem follow-up doc and scheduling a 30m sync in 4 days. link: https://docs.redwood/eng-runtime/kv-oom-followup

kevin nguyen: short-term fallback plan if cap/eviction causes issues: route reads to warmed replica (flag routing.kv.fallback=true). adding a dashboard panel to visualize miss-rate vs p95.

jade lim: quick repro I'm using on staging (small script):
```
for i in {1..20000}; do
  size=$(( (i % 7 + 1) * 32 * 1024 ))
  http POST https://staging-kv/set k=$i v=@<(head -c $size /dev/urandom)
done
```

samir patel: staging compaction bench preliminary: frag index 0.46 -> 0.30, CPU +3.2%. sharing /dash/kv/frag-bench.

omar ali: long-term backlog items (track as follow-ups):
- L1: slab allocator / pooled arenas for hot size-classes (owner: samir + kevin) - ETA 6w
- L2: zero-copy serialization for large values (>64KB) (owner: jade) - ETA 3w
- L3: synthetic CI job to reproduce fragmentation pattern weekly (owner: jade) - ETA 2w
- L4: jemalloc tuning & allocator defaults review (owner: kevin) - ETA 4w

kevin nguyen: added L4 to sprint board. will spike on arena reuse first.

jade lim: S2 canary deployed to 2% on shard-e at 07:10 UTC, monitoring now.

samir patel: heap sampler active; uploading first round diffs.

omar ali: recording owners & timelines in follow-up doc. scheduling retro 7 days out to reassess.

kevin nguyen: S1 PR opened, includes telemetry and canary flags.

jade lim: EOD update: canary stable at 2% for 90m, no p95 regression, memory plateaued. promoting to 20% in morning window.

samir patel: staging compaction numbers look promising; will run extended run tomorrow.

omar ali: summary for tracking doc: S1(kevin,24h), S2(jade,8h), S3(samir,1h), S4(omar,3h); L1(samir+kevin,6w), L2(jade,3w), L3(jade,2w), L4(kevin,4w). thread will remain canonical tracker.

jade lim: thanks all. will post heap diffs and CI artifacts when ready.

kevin nguyen: setting a weekly reminder "kv-frag-scan" to catch slow regressions.

omar ali: closing for now; will reopen if canary regresses or new OOMs appear.
